name: Claude CoWork Sub-Agents Guide 🤖
description_md:
# What You Get

- 
Comprehensive PDF Guide (30+ Pages): A complete walkthrough of Claude Co-work's sub-agent system with step-by-step instructions

- 
Built-In Agents Reference: Detailed breakdown of every pre-configured sub-agent and when to use each one

- 
Custom Agent Templates: Ready-to-use templates for creating your own specialized agents (Research, QA, Analysis, Content)

- 
The 4-Phase Workflow Pattern: The exact Research > Plan > Execute > QA pattern used by power users

- 
5 Real-World Use Cases: Detailed examples including competitive analysis, content repurposing, proposal generation, and more

- 
Persistence System: How to save your agents and workflows so you can reuse them across sessions

- 
Context Management Strategies: Keep your conversations clean and avoid the dreaded auto-compaction

- 
Troubleshooting Guide: Solutions to the most common sub-agent issues

After downloading, join us in the community to share your workflows, get feedback, and stay ahead of the AI curve:
https://www.skool.com/earlyaidopters/about
